answer: A farm of 280 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in walnut, queued in oasis, and relic publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 92 identities per epoch. A farm of 3974 identities would post 552 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
